<?php

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private int $maxConnections;
    private int $activeCount = 0;

    public function __construct(int $max = 10) {
        $this->maxConnections = $max;
    }

    public function acquire(): ?PDO {
        if ($this->activeCount < $this->maxConnections) {
            $conn = new PDO('mysql:host=localhost;dbname=payments', 'app', 'secret');
            $conn->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
            $this->activeCount++;
            return $conn;
        }
        return array_pop($this->connections);
    }

    public function release(PDO $conn): void {
        $this->activeCount--;
        $this->connections[] = $conn;
    }
}

class PaymentLedger {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private const PRECISION_FACTOR = 100; // Store cents as integers
    private const MAX_REFUND_CENTS = 99999999; // ~$999,999.99

    public function __construct(ConnectionPool $pool) {
        $this->pool = $pool;
    }

    /**
     * Computes the net balance adjustment for a refund operation.
     * Uses integer arithmetic to avoid floating-point errors.
     * 
     * @param int $originalAmountCents - original charge in cents (positive)
     * @param int $partialRefundCents - amount already refunded in cents (positive)
     * @param int $newRefundRequestCents - new refund request in cents (positive)
     * @return int - the adjustment to apply (negative = debit from merchant)
     */
    public function computeRefundAdjustment(
        int $originalAmountCents,
        int $partialRefundCents,
        int $newRefundRequestCents
    ): int {
        // Calculate remaining refundable amount
        $remainingRefundable = $originalAmountCents - $partialRefundCents;
        
        // Cap the refund at what's remaining
        $effectiveRefund = min($newRefundRequestCents, $remainingRefundable);
        
        // Apply platform fee retention (2.5% kept on refunds)
        $platformFeeRetention = $this->calculateFeeRetention($effectiveRefund);
        
        // Net adjustment: negative of (refund minus retained fee)
        $netAdjustment = -($effectiveRefund - $platformFeeRetention);
        
        return $netAdjustment;
    }

    /**
     * Calculate the fee retention on a refund amount.
     * Platform retains 2.5% processing fee even on refunds.
     */
    private function calculateFeeRetention(int $amountCents): int {
        // Integer division: 250 basis points = 2.5%
        // We multiply first then divide to maintain precision
        return intdiv($amountCents * 250, 10000);
    }

    /**
     * Process a batch refund with multiple line items.
     * Each line item has: transaction_id, refund_amount_cents
     */
    public function processBatchRefund(array $lineItems, string $merchantId): array {
        $conn = $this->pool->acquire();
        if (!$conn) {
            return ['error' => 'No available connections'];
        }

        try {
            $conn->beginTransaction();
            $totalAdjustment = 0;
            $results = [];

            foreach ($lineItems as $item) {
                $txnId = $item['transaction_id'];
                $requestedRefund = $item['refund_amount_cents'];

                // Validate refund cap
                if ($requestedRefund > self::MAX_REFUND_CENTS) {
                    $results[] = ['txn' => $txnId, 'status' => 'rejected', 'reason' => 'exceeds_max'];
                    continue;
                }

                // Fetch original transaction details
                $stmt = $conn->prepare(
                    'SELECT amount_cents, refunded_cents FROM transactions WHERE id = ? AND merchant_id = ?'
                );
                $stmt->execute([$txnId, $merchantId]);
                $txn = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                if (!$txn) {
                    $results[] = ['txn' => $txnId, 'status' => 'not_found'];
                    continue;
                }

                $originalAmount = (int)$txn['amount_cents'];
                $alreadyRefunded = (int)$txn['refunded_cents'];

                // Compute the adjustment using our integer arithmetic engine
                $adjustment = $this->computeRefundAdjustment(
                    $originalAmount,
                    $alreadyRefunded,
                    $requestedRefund
                );

                // Apply the ledger entry
                $this->applyLedgerEntry($conn, $merchantId, $txnId, $adjustment);
                
                // Update refunded total on the transaction
                $effectiveRefund = min($requestedRefund, $originalAmount - $alreadyRefunded);
                $stmt = $conn->prepare(
                    'UPDATE transactions SET refunded_cents = refunded_cents + ? WHERE id = ?'
                );
                $stmt->execute([$effectiveRefund, $txnId]);

                $totalAdjustment += $adjustment;
                $results[] = ['txn' => $txnId, 'status' => 'processed', 'adjustment' => $adjustment];
            }

            // Update merchant balance
            $stmt = $conn->prepare(
                'UPDATE merchant_balances SET balance_cents = balance_cents + ? WHERE merchant_id = ?'
            );
            $stmt->execute([$totalAdjustment, $merchantId]);

            $conn->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'total_adjustment' => $totalAdjustment, 'items' => $results];

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $conn->rollBack();
            return ['error' => $e->getMessage()];
        } finally {
            $this->pool->release($conn);
        }
    }

    private function applyLedgerEntry(PDO $conn, string $merchantId, string $txnId, int $amount): void {
        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO ledger_entries (merchant_id, transaction_id, amount_cents, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, NOW())'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$merchantId, $txnId, $amount]);
    }
}

// Entry point for API
function handleRefundRequest(array $requestBody): array {
    $pool = new ConnectionPool(5);
    $ledger = new PaymentLedger($pool);

    $merchantId = $requestBody['merchant_id'] ?? '';
    $lineItems = $requestBody['line_items'] ?? [];

    if (empty($merchantId) || empty($lineItems)) {
        return ['error' => 'Invalid request'];
    }

    // Validate line items structure
    foreach ($lineItems as $item) {
        if (!isset($item['transaction_id']) || !isset($item['refund_amount_cents'])) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid line item structure'];
        }
        if (!is_int($item['refund_amount_cents']) || $item['refund_amount_cents'] < 0) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid refund amount'];
        }
    }

    return $ledger->processBatchRefund($lineItems, $merchantId);
}
